Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Carbon Brushes of 
 Generator, Exciter,

and 
 Earthing Brushes
 VE 50
SKODA EXPORT
Introduction

This 
document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2, which must be performed 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The
 Brush Dimension 25x32x64 mm, Rated Current Density 9.5 A/cm2, Brush Holders R2532

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, tested by eng. Enas Azmy, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Tawfik El sayed Tawfik, accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Whab; general 
director, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.
The unit must be out of service.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete tool set.
New brushes, Grading m/c
Blower, megger device and digital voltmeter.

Fine cloth for 
 cleaning purposes.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Remove the brushes of 
generator, exciter and earthing brushes from their holders
Remove brushes holders

Clean brushes slip ring 
contact

Before and after cleaning 
brushes slip ring contact measure the insulation resistance between slip ring and 
earth by using megger device 500 V.D.C. "approximately
≥ 10 M Ω"
Clean brushes holders.

Before and after cleaning 
brushes holders measure the insulation resistance between holders and earth by 
using megger device 500 V.D.C. "approximately ≥ 10 
MΩ" (recording in table2)

Measure the deeps of slip 
ring "approximately > 1m.m "(according the reading 
in table 3, will state for grading or not)

Put holders in their 
position and tightening it

Check the clearance 
between brushes holders and slip ring "approximately 3 m.m"

Replace the brush by a new 
one if its height falls to 25 mm.
Check connection of cables of brushes must be tightened.
Put the unit in service.

Inspect 
the brush vibration.

Inspect 
the sparking brushes.

items:
Remove the brushes of 
generator, exciter and earthing brushes from their holders
Remove brushes holders

Clean brushes slip ring 
contact

Before and after cleaning 
brushes slip ring contact measure the insulation resistance between slip ring and 
earth by using megger device 500 V.D.C. "approximately
≥ 10 M Ω"
Clean brushes holders.

Before and after cleaning 
brushes holders measure the insulation resistance between holders and earth by 
using megger device 500 V.D.C. "approximately ≥ 10 
MΩ" (recording in table2)

Measure the deeps of slip 
ring "approximately > 1m.m "(according the reading 
in table 3, will state for grading or not)

Put holders in their 
position and tightening it

Check the clearance 
between brushes holders and slip ring "approximately 3 m.m"

Replace the brush by a new 
one if its height falls to 25 mm.

Check brushes must move freely in the holders and must sit 
 to the rings by their full surface.

Check brush pressure in permanently given by the 
 holding-down system of the holders.
Check connection of cables of brushes must be tightened.
Put the unit in service.

Inspect 
the brush vibration.

Inspect 
the sparking brushes.

Measure the 
 current in each brush and recording it in table (1) "if the current in any 
 brush less than 10A (according to the recommendation from specialist), replace 
 it"

Measure the 
 leakage AC voltage between bearings of generator as fig (1) "approximately
 ≥ 2 V.A.C"
